command:
set -eu
export_file=/srv/legacy2/mysql-relational-import/orders.sql
report_host=$(printf '%s\n' "$CLUSTER_HOSTS" | awk '$2=="node2" {print $1}')
[ -n "$report_host" ]
admin_pw=$(openssl rand -hex 24)
report_pw=$(openssl rand -hex 24)
sudo -n mysql --protocol=socket < "$export_file"
sudo -n mysql --protocol=socket <<MYSQL_SETUP
CREATE USER 'branch_admin'@'localhost' IDENTIFIED BY [REDACTED];
GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON branch_orders.* TO 'branch_admin'@'localhost';
CREATE USER 'branch_report'@'$report_host' IDENTIFIED BY [REDACTED];
GRANT SELECT ON branch_orders.customers TO 'branch_report'@'$report_host';
GRANT SELECT ON branch_orders.orders TO 'branch_report'@'$report_host';
FLUSH PRIVILEGES;
MYSQL_SETUP
umask 077
printf '[client]\nuser=branch_admin\npassword=[REDACTED] "$admin_pw" > /tmp/branch-admin.cnf
printf '[client]\nhost=%s\nport=3306\nuser=branch_report\npassword=[REDACTED] "$NODE_IP" "$report_pw" > /tmp/branch-report.cnf
sudo -n install -o root -g root -m 600 /tmp/branch-admin.cnf /root/.branch-admin.cnf
rm -f /tmp/branch-admin.cnf
printf 'database imported; accounts created; node2 grant host=%s\n' "$report_host"
sudo -n mysql --protocol=socket -NBe "SELECT TABLE_NAME,ENGINE,TABLE_ROWS FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='branch_orders' ORDER BY TABLE_NAME; SHOW CREATE TABLE branch_orders.orders; SELECT User,Host FROM mysql.user WHERE User IN ('branch_admin','branch_report') ORDER BY User,Host; SHOW GRANTS FOR 'branch_report'@'$report_host'; SHOW GRANTS FOR 'branch_admin'@'localhost';"
sha256sum "$export_file"
